facets.description: getShortcut() javadoc in OAuth2GrantTypeFactory says 'usually like 3-letters', but DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider.getTokenContextFromTokenId requires exactly 2 characters (6-char prefix), so a 3-letter shortcut produces token IDs that cannot be decoded

Nothing checks that the shortcut is non-null and exactly 2 characters; a null shortcut throws an NPE on the ConcurrentHashMap put in DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit and server startup fails
getShortcut() is a new abstract SPI method with no default implementation, so existing custom OAuth2GrantTypeFactory implementations stop compiling or hit AbstractMethodError
